needs.premise: One native call and a completed second receipt; separate raw effect/ready, partial gate writes, cooperative cancellation, qualified stop premise, prefix floor and record pins; no weak-memory/native crash recovery
Conditional settlement Step/Trace conservation, no-observation decoder, restoration and reclamation guards, floor induction and bounded-window metadata; no C simulation

Publish qualified native participation and frozen context roots before acceptance; no-escape raw-enter through ready publication: cancellation/handler policy established before acceptance; no Scheme checkpoint, callback, logging, foreign unwind or local-only result ownership; OS preemption remains allowed

Expected gate failures only before shared writes; finish cooperative writes and publish commit before unlock; unexpected nonlocal exit or owner death poisons gate/domain rather than blind cleanup unlock or refund

Before restoring masks/cancellation or propagating Scheme errors: release gate, publish outcome, retain result/root in stable service and restore VM/processor binding; stopped owner recovery needs independent scan/stop evidence

Record reuse requires settled outcome, producer closure, acknowledged replay-right retirement, published nonregressing floor and drained raw pins; ID-only stale handles rejected before lookup; no timeout or ACK-only free
Backend result captured before completion release publication; caller delivery is separate; raw effect before capture remains unqueryable without a qualified cooperative adapter
Exact operation/domain/block/grant generations and one gate jointly apply charge and consumed state; replay only queries completion; no duplicate free or credit
Same short domain gate protects owner, revisions, intents, writer and sweep leases and admission; pending native calls exclude commit; no raw allocation, finalizer or GC under gate

Retire and unique release permit under gate after scan/root/raw-reader closure; native call outside gate; unknown outcome retains charge and release exclusion; metadata outlives payload without raw authority
Real PSTATE, effective binding, VM and catcher restore are separately established on every admitted exit
Still preparation, foreign cleanup, native borrower drain and retained capacity charged exactly once before backing release

completionCosts.condition: Robust mutex or cleanup unlock alone does not establish consistency

nodes.labelText: Native call -> ready publication\nno escape; preemption allowed
Raw gap / dead-held gate\nretain custody; refuse handoff
Stable result roots + VM binding\nrestore masks/cancel outside gate
ACK + producer closure\nadvance nonregressing replay floor
Drain raw record pins\nreject old keys before lookup
Reuse record slot\npool backing remains reserved
SysML -> ASCENT\nQNT / Lean; source gaps open

callers.actualChain: malloc/free or code mmap/munmap -> logging/header/aligned-container construction
callers.hazard: Current outer wrappers cannot publish before earlier raw effects and debug vfprintf/fflush
callers.replacement: Move logging out of raw-to-ready envelope; record raw backing before fallible view initialization

callers.actualChain: raise interrupt -> flags/stack trip; disable retains synchronous operation interrupt
callers.hazard: Scheme interrupt mask neither pthread cancellation control nor no-GC-region proof
callers.replacement: Reuse deferred request mechanism; add explicit checkpoint/participation admission

callers.actualChain: thread_sigmask -> pthread_sigmask or sigprocmask returns int
callers.hazard: Calling convention/error channel differs; nested restoration needs exact saved state
callers.replacement: Use status-bearing per-profile primitive; never fabricate a mask-success receipt

callers.hazard: Void high-level APIs discard three enter and three restore return values
callers.replacement: Preserve LIFO idea; typed partial-mask setup/restore results and retained saved masks required

callers.actualChain: device-process setup or system call inside mask-all pair
callers.hazard: These real users do blocking/native resource work; normal lexical pairing is not exceptional cleanup
callers.replacement: Keep own domains; no generic atomicity inferred from mask wrapper reuse

callers.actualChain: heartbeat/TTY callback dispatch, SIGCONT device restore, SIGCHLD waitpid with errno save/restore, optional crash handler
callers.hazard: Callback identity, errno preservation and installed configuration are not globally closed
callers.replacement: Selective audited returning handlers or qualified masking; crash/foreign handler escapes refuse recovery

callers.actualChain: C TRY uses setjmp/catcher and THROW longjmp; call/run may rethrow; C cleanup is ordinary code
callers.hazard: C cleanup has no automatic destructor guarantee; foreign catch cannot repair partially written metadata
callers.replacement: Expected errors returned outside gate; no Scheme/foreign call or THROW while mutable transaction active

callers.actualChain: make marker may allocate; callback call; normal path invalidates marker
callers.hazard: Explicit pre-allocation root TODO; marker kill is not receipt ACK or alias drain
callers.replacement: Protect values before marker allocation; service roots and binding independent of dead C frame

callers.actualChain: release clears hook/pointer -> arbitrary native destructor; sweep frees afterward
callers.hazard: Cleared fields do not prove completion; hook may reenter, escape or block
callers.replacement: Separate destructor acceptance/completion from backing release; never run hook under gate

callers.actualChain: cleanup_pstate -> pthread_exit; processor0 join ignores error; exported exit/join
callers.hazard: Join or stop alone gives no raw outcome; exported host calls bypass local census
callers.replacement: Stop credential binds thread generation, phase, roots and gate; raw/poisoned state refuses handoff

callers.actualChain: Executable-path native buffer malloc -> Scheme conversion -> free
callers.hazard: Direct backend bypass plus Scheme allocation while native buffer live
callers.replacement: Separate buffer domain; retain native buffer custody across conversion and error paths
